verification.tier: independently reviewed static binary contracts and source caller
verification.registration: The Group service registers setHeader against the inspected wrapper binding.
verification.receiver: For both admitted profiles, the normal Session supplier and JavaScript wrapper preserve the concrete Group receiver used by setHeader. Linux ARM64 startup stores the primary Session object in the shared map; the account lookup preserves that object through the Group supplier and JavaScript wrapper. The separate shell interface is not substituted for the account receiver.
verification.linuxArm64Replay: Pinned ELF bytes independently replayed against function hashes, instructions, direct branches, relocations, literals and imported symbols; a separate program-segment mapping confirmed the inspected bytes. Registration, concrete receiver supply, arguments and normal callback result were reviewed together.
arguments: UTF-8 string converted by base-10 unsigned 64-bit parsing for the group number
UTF-8 string passed to the operation as the image pathname
verification.callback: The concrete operation forwards int32 status and UTF-8 error text through the captured callback to the normal promise result codec.

sdkPolicy.groupId: positive decimal string within uint64, preserving spelling and precision
sdkPolicy.file: stable absolute local path with no NUL, readable nonempty regular file
sdkPolicy.success: Numeric result zero acknowledges the native operation. It does not prove remote propagation.
sdkPolicy.failure: Nonzero status preserves its numeric code; malformed result rejects. Native errMsg is not exposed.
sdkPolicy.retry: No automatic retry. Timeout or retirement after dispatch may leave the remote effect unknown.

limitations: No native invocation or remote group avatar change has been tested for this operation.
Queue scheduling, callback timing and every internal transport path were not exhaustively inspected. An unavailable service path can omit the callback.
Image encoding and size constraints, permissions, server policy and avatar cache propagation remain unverified.
Other platform/version/hash combinations are unsupported until independently verified.
